title: Affine etale tests detect constructible subsets of qcqs algebraic spaces
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $X$ an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], with its atlas point topology [def-a1-space-point-topology]. Assume $|X|$ is quasi-compact (every open cover has a finite subcover) and $X$ is quasi-separated (its diagonal is quasi-compact). A morphism of spaces is quasi-compact when its base change by every affine scheme has quasi-compact source point space. Let $E\subseteq|X|$ be any subset. Then $E$ is constructible [def-weil-constructible-subset] if and only if, for every affine $S$-scheme $U$ (a scheme isomorphic to the spectrum of a commutative ring [def-weil-affine-spectrum]) and every representable etale morphism $u:U\to X$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], the inverse image $|u|^{-1}(E)$ is constructible in $|U|$.

source.place: Tag 0ECZ (lemma-locally-constructible), including the proof after the quasi-compact reduction, which proves global constructibility for a qcqs space; affine etale tests are spaces-properties.tex Tag 0ECT (lemma-locally-constructible), condition (2), and Tag 0ECU (definition-locally-constructible).

proof.text: First make the quasi-compactness comparison used below explicit. If $g:A\to X$ is quasi-compact and $W\subseteq|X|$ is quasi-compact open, its open subspace has an affine surjective etale atlas $B\to W$. By the affine-test definition, $A\times_XB$ is quasi-compact. Its point map to $A$ is continuous and has image exactly $|g|^{-1}(W)$: the point-fibre-product image formula applies and $|B|\to W$ is surjective. Thus that inverse image is quasi-compact by the continuous-image lemma. This argument applies also when $A$ is a scheme and does not require $W$ to be affine.

source.place: Tag 0ECZ (lemma-locally-constructible), first proof paragraph, quasi-compact point-map comparison; affine atlas input Tag 03H6.

proof.text: Suppose $E$ is constructible and take an affine etale test $u:U\to X$. The affine scheme $U$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, so its point space is spectral. Since $X$ is quasi-separated, the quasi-compact-source permanence lemma makes $u$ quasi-compact. By the preceding step, inverse images of quasi-compact opens are quasi-compact. The new spectral-space lemma applies to $X$; in each of $|X|$ and $|U|$ retrocompact opens are exactly quasi-compact opens. The point map is continuous. The constructible-preimage lemma therefore gives $|u|^{-1}(E)$ constructible, proving the forward implication.

source.place: Tag 0ECZ (lemma-locally-constructible), forward implication, using Topology Tags 0069 and 005I.

proof.text: Conversely assume the affine etale tests are constructible. View $X$ over $\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$ by change of base scheme and apply the existing qcqs splitting-filtration lemma. Obtain quasi-compact opens $\varnothing=U_{n+1}\subset U_n\subset\cdots\subset U_1=X$, quasi-compact separated schemes $V_p$, and surjective etale maps $f_p:V_p\to U_p$ which are isomorphisms over the reduced closed strata $T_p=U_p\setminus U_{p+1}$. The equivalence with spaces over $S$ supplies all these objects with their maps to $S$; its small-etale-site identification retains the etale charts, and the unchanged atlas gives the same point topology. Write $g_p:V_p\to X$ for the composite. Open subspace inclusions are representable etale: on scheme tests they are open immersions, hence etale. Composition of representable etale maps makes $g_p$, and then its restriction to every affine open $B\subset V_p$, an allowed test.

source.place: Tag 0ECZ (lemma-locally-constructible), converse, choice of filtration from Tag 07ST; change of base scheme Tag 03I4.

proof.text: For each $p$, put $E_p=|g_p|^{-1}(E)$. On each affine open $B\subset V_p$, the hypothesis says $E_p\cap B$ is constructible in $B$; these affine neighborhoods show $E_p$ is locally constructible. The scheme $V_p$ is quasi-compact and separated; separatedness implies quasi-separatedness. The scheme local-to-global constructibility lemma gives $E_p$ constructible in $|V_p|$. Its point space is spectral by the qcqs-scheme lemma. Also $g_p$ is quasi-compact by quasi-compact-source permanence since its target is the quasi-separated space $X$.

source.place: Tag 0ECZ (lemma-locally-constructible), converse: constructibility of E_p in the qc separated scheme V_p.

proof.text: The open subset $O_p=|g_p|^{-1}(|U_{p+1}|)$ is quasi-compact by step 1. Since $|V_p|$ is spectral, $O_p$ is retrocompact, so $Z_p=|V_p|\setminus O_p$ is constructible in $|V_p|$. Constructible intersection in a constructible subspace gives $E_p\cap Z_p$ constructible in $Z_p$. The closed-subspace point comparison identifies $Z_p$ homeomorphically with the point space of $V_p\times_{U_p}T_p$; the filtration isomorphism then identifies it homeomorphically with $|T_p|$. The point map of this isomorphism and of its inverse are continuous, and $U_p\to X$ identifies its point topology with an open subspace topology. Hence the transported subset is exactly $E\cap|T_p|$, constructible in the subspace $|T_p|\subseteq|X|$. A homeomorphism preserves open sets, quasi-compactness and their intersections, and therefore preserves retrocompactness and the displayed finite Boolean presentations of constructible sets.

source.place: Tag 0ECZ (lemma-locally-constructible), converse: restriction to f_p^{-1}(T_p), using the constructible-subspace form Topology Tag 09YI in place of Tag 09YE.

proof.text: Finally, $|U_p|$ and $|U_{p+1}|$ are quasi-compact opens in the spectral space $|X|$, hence retrocompact. Their difference $|T_p|$ is constructible in $|X|$. By the existing constructible-in-constructible lemma, the constructible subset $E\cap|T_p|$ of $|T_p|$ is constructible in $|X|$. The finitely many differences cover $|X|$, so $E=\bigcup_{p=1}^n(E\cap|T_p|)$ is constructible by closure under finite unions. This also covers empty strata and the empty space.

source.place: Tag 0ECZ (lemma-locally-constructible), final finite union; Topology Tags 09YJ and 005H provide the two elementary assembly operations underlying Tag 09YK.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0ECZ (lemma-locally-constructible), both implications in the qcqs case; converse uses the same Tag 07ST filtration.
